title: Codemap
description: A portable, git-trackable artifact describing an AI-generated, task-specific trace of how a feature/flow works in a codebase.

version.description: Schema version of this codemap artifact.

id.description: Stable, human-readable identifier for the codemap (e.g. 'auth-flow-2026-07-25').

query.description: The natural-language task the codemap answers.

overview.description: A short narrative summary of the whole flow, referencing traces by id in square brackets (e.g. '...router init [1a]...').

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the codemap was generated.

traces.description: Tree of trace nodes. Root-level entries are the top of the tree; nesting is expressed via child ids.

log.description: Optional structured record of every tool call the agent made while producing this codemap. Used for eval/debugging.

mode.description: Whether inference ran against a cloud API or a local runtime.

root.description: Absolute path to the repository root at generation time.

commit.description: Git commit hash the codemap was generated against, if available.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the source file.

id.description: Unique id of the trace node within this codemap.

summary.description: One- to three-sentence explanation of what happens here.

motivation.description: Optional explanation of why this section exists in the architecture.

details.description: Optional expanded implementation guide for this section.

locations.description: Exact file + line ranges that ground this step.

children.description: Ids of child trace nodes (tree structure).

Confidence.description: Per-trace honesty signal separating deterministic location verification from probabilistic summary grounding.

location_verified.description: Deterministic: do this trace's locations resolve in the repo? No model call.

location_evidence.description: How the location was confirmed: matched symbol (strongest), file+line only, or nothing.

summary_grounded.description: Optional probabilistic score (0..1) that a second-pass read of the code supports the summary.

format.description: Diagram source format. Only mermaid is supported in v1.
